verdict.rationale: GlitchTip's own site says the product is open source and that users can view, modify and use the code, which covers the story's core. Its self-hostable Docker and Helm distribution fits that claim. Missing for 10: the specific open license is not named, there is no link to the source repository, and no independent corroboration of license terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: It's also open source, so you can view, modify, and use the code as you see fit. Run it on your server, or let us host it for you.
A Helm chart is available for Kubernetes.
